An input pair of 6 um gives ~2 mS during integration. Latch tau ≈ 25 fF / 1.5 mS ≈ 17 ps; ln(900/(Av·2 mV)) ≈ 4 gives ~70 ps regeneration. Add ~40 ps integration and ~25 ps for the inverters. Reset PMOS on all four internal nodes gives equal outputs during reset. Output inverters isolate CL from the latch."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":   (6.0, 2.0, 16.0),   # input pair width (um), L=0.15
    "W_tail": (6.0, 2.0, 16.0),   # clocked tail switch width
    "W_ln":   (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # latch NMOS width
    "W_lp":   (2.0, 0.84, 6.0),   # latch PMOS width
    "W_rst":  (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # reset PMOS width
    "W_invn": (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # output inverter NMOS width
    "r_inv":  (2.0, 1.0, 3.5),    # inverter PMOS/NMOS width ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    L = 0.15
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    fclk = spec.get("fclk", 500e6)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    Win, Wt, Wln, Wlp, Wr, Wn = p["W_in"], p["W_tail"], p["W_ln"], p["W_lp"], p["W_rst"], p["W_invn"]
    Wip = Wn * p["r_inv"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail
    n.M("MT", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, L)
    # input pair: vinp -> node p1 (feeds latch node xn), vinn -> p2 (feeds xp)
    n.M("M1", "p1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    n.M("M2", "p2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    # cross-coupled NMOS
    n.M("M3", "xn", "xp", "p1", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M4", "xp", "xn", "p2", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    # cross-coupled PMOS
    n.M("M5", "xn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M6", "xp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "xn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR2", "xp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR3", "p1", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR4", "p2", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    # output inverters: vinp>vinn -> xn falls first -> outp high
    n.M("MI1N", "outp", "xn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, L)
    n.M("MI1P", "outp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wip, L)
    n.M("MI2N", "outn", "xp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, L)
    n.M("MI2P", "outn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wip, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cpu = 1.6e-15  # approx gate+junction cap per um width at L=0.15
    # input pair during integration (VGS=0.9, tail partially on)
    opi = lut.op("n", Win, L, 0.9, 0.3)
    gm_in = max(opi["gm"], 1e-4)
    Id_in = max(opi["Id"], 1e-5)
    Cp = cpu * (Win + Wln + Wr)                  # p1/p2 node
    Cx = cpu * (Wln + Wlp + Wr + Wn + Wip) + cpu * (Wln + Wlp)  # latch node incl. cross gates
    # integration: discharge Cp+Cx by ~Vthn with current Id_in
    t_int = (Cp + Cx) * 0.65 / Id_in
    Av = gm_in * t_int / max(Cx, 1e-16)
    Av = max(min(Av, 20.0), 1.0)
    opl = lut.op("n", Wln, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    opp = lut.op("p", Wlp, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    gm_l = opl["gm"] + opp["gm"]
    tau = Cx / max(gm_l, 1e-5)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(max(VDD / 2 / (Av * dv), 2.0))
    Cout = CL + cpu * (Wn + Wip)
    opinv = lut.op("n", Wn, L, 1.8, 0.9)
    t_inv = 0.69 * Cout * (VDD / 2) / max(opinv["Id"], 1e-6) * 0.7
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv

    Csw = 2 * (Cp + Cx) + Cout + cpu * Wt + 2 * cpu * Wr * 0.5 + cpu * 2 * (Wn + Wip) * 0.5
    energy = Csw * VDD ** 2 + 2 * Cout * VDD ** 2 * 0.1
    return n, {"delay": delay, "energy": energy, "correct": 1}
```
